+"""Regression test for parsing escaped quotes in an isql CONNECT role."""
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import uuid
+
+
+def run(argv, sql, timeout=90):
+    return subprocess.run(
+        argv,
+        input=sql,
+        text=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        timeout=timeout,
+        check=False,
+    )
+
+
+def sql_identifier(value):
+    return '"' + value.replace('"', '""') + '"'
+
+
+def sql_string(value):
+    return "'" + value.replace("'", "''") + "'"
+
+
+def main():
+    dsn = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_FIREBIRD_DSN")
+    if not dsn:
+        raise RuntimeError("ACREPAIR_FIREBIRD_DSN is required")
+
+    isql = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_ISQL", "isql")
+    admin = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_ADMIN_USER", "SYSDBA")
+    admin_password = os.environ.get(
+        "ACREPAIR_PASSWORD_" + admin.upper(), "masterkey"
+    )
+    suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:10].upper()
+    user = "AC_ROLE_PARSE_USER_" + suffix
+    user_password = "role_parse_" + suffix.lower()
+    role = 'AC ROLE""Q' + suffix
+    role_sql = sql_identifier(role)
+    admin_cmd = [isql, "-user", admin, "-password", admin_password, dsn]
+
+    setup_sql = (
+        "SET BAIL ON;\n"
+        f"CREATE USER {user} PASSWORD {sql_string(user_password)};\n"
+        f"CREATE ROLE {role_sql};\n"
+        f"GRANT {role_sql} TO {user};\n"
+        "COMMIT;\n"
+    )
+    setup = run(admin_cmd, setup_sql)
+    if setup.returncode != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "Could not create the quoted-role fixture: " + setup.stdout + setup.stderr
+        )
+
+    # This command-line grammar intentionally mirrors the report's CONNECT example.
+    connect_sql = (
+        "SET BAIL ON;\n"
+        f"CONNECT {sql_string(dsn)} USER {sql_string(user)} "
+        f"PASSWORD {sql_string(user_password)} ROLE {role_sql};\n"
+        "SELECT CASE WHEN CURRENT_ROLE = "
+        f"{sql_string(role)} THEN 'ROLE_PARSE_OK' ELSE 'ROLE_PARSE_BAD' END "
+        "FROM RDB$DATABASE;\n"
+    )
+    try:
+        target = run(admin_cmd, connect_sql)
+    finally:
+        cleanup_sql = (
+            "SET BAIL OFF;\n"
+            f"REVOKE {role_sql} FROM {user};\n"
+            f"DROP ROLE {role_sql};\n"
+            f"DROP USER {user};\n"
+            "COMMIT;\n"
+        )
+        run(admin_cmd, cleanup_sql, timeout=60)
+
+    passed = target.returncode == 0 and "ROLE_PARSE_OK" in target.stdout
+    result = {
+        "checks": [
+            {
+                "name": "isql_connect_preserves_escaped_quote_role_name",
+                "kind": "target",
+                "passed": passed,
+                "expected": {"success": True, "stdout_contains": "ROLE_PARSE_OK"},
+                "actual": {
+                    "returncode": target.returncode,
+                    "stdout": target.stdout,
+                    "stderr": target.stderr,
+                },
+            }
+        ],
+        "reproduced": not passed,
+        "origin": "generated_from_report_reproduction",
+    }
+    print("CHECK_RESULT=" + json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        main()
+    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired, RuntimeError) as exc:
+        print("TEST_INFRA_ERROR=" + str(exc), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
+        sys.exit(2)

+-- Conceptual SQL for the custom test.py parser regression.
+-- actual role name contains two consecutive double-quote characters.
+CREATE USER AC_ROLE_PARSE_USER_<suffix> PASSWORD '<temporary-password>';
+CREATE ROLE "AC ROLE""""Q<suffix>";
+GRANT "AC ROLE""""Q<suffix>" TO AC_ROLE_PARSE_USER_<suffix>;
+COMMIT;
+
+-- A separate isql session runs the CONNECT command and verifies CURRENT_ROLE.
+CONNECT '<ACREPAIR_FIREBIRD_DSN>' USER 'AC_ROLE_PARSE_USER_<suffix>'
+  PASSWORD '<temporary-password>' ROLE "AC ROLE""""Q<suffix>";
+SELECT CASE WHEN CURRENT_ROLE = 'AC ROLE""Q<suffix>'
+            THEN 'ROLE_PARSE_OK' ELSE 'ROLE_PARSE_BAD' END
+FROM RDB$DATABASE;
